note: Only one client family runs against a Reverie server today. Statuses change only after a real client has joined, dressed its avatar and entered a room on a Reverie build.

statuses.upstream: Worked on Mocha's production server. Not yet re-tested on Reverie.
statuses.tested: Joined and played on a Reverie build.

clients.notes: Mocha's target client. Players install ReveriePatcher (MelonLoader) and set your server's https address. Sign-up, login, avatar, profile and joining the dorm over Photon were tested on Reverie with 20230414. New servers use a shared Photon app until the host adds their own.
Mocha's API is 2023-shaped. Earlier builds use different auth and avatar endpoints.
RebornRec's catalogs (bundled) come from this era, but its server is closed-source, so its API behaviour has to be rebuilt.
